description: POST request with the v1.5 OPTIONAL `tag` parameter set to "task". Exercises RFC 9421 §2.3 sf-string serialization; tag appears in the Signature-Input AND the signature base (between nonce and the trailing close-paren of @signature-params).
verifier_assertions: Signature-Input contains `tag="task"` after the nonce parameter
Signature base includes the tag parameter in the @signature-params line, byte-identical to Signature-Input minus the `sig1=` prefix
An RFC 8941 §3.3.3 sf-string parser accepts the tag value `task` as a valid bare token wrapped in DQUOTE
A verifier configured to enforce tag="task" for /api/task accepts this request; a verifier configured to enforce tag="heartbeat" rejects it
